processDefinition.name: customer_tag_update
processDefinition.description: 客户标签更新DAG：从customer主表与transaction聚合计算客户业务/风险标签，写入customer_tag表

taskDefinitionList.name: extract_customer_basic
taskDefinitionList.description: 抽取customer主表当日有效客户到临时表tmp_customer_tag_src

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_tag_src PARTITION (p_${biz_date}) SELECT customer_id, customer_type, register_at, status FROM ${db_finance}.customer WHERE updated_at >= '${biz_date} 00:00:00' AND updated_at < '${biz_date} 23:59:59' OR status = 'ACTIVE';

taskDefinitionList.name: aggregate_transaction_stat
taskDefinitionList.description: 聚合transaction近30天交易统计：交易笔数/金额/活跃天数，作为标签计算输入

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_txn_agg PARTITION (p_${biz_date}) SELECT customer_id, COUNT(1) AS txn_cnt_30d, SUM(amount) AS txn_amt_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(occurred_at)) AS active_days_30d FROM ${db_finance}.transaction WHERE occurred_at >= DATE_SUB('${biz_date}', INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND occurred_at <= '${biz_date}' GROUP BY customer_id;

taskDefinitionList.name: compute_customer_tag
taskDefinitionList.description: 根据客户基础信息与交易聚合计算标签：active/vip/dormant/high_value等

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_tag_calc PARTITION (p_${biz_date}) SELECT c.customer_id, CASE WHEN t.txn_cnt_30d >= 20 THEN 'high_active' WHEN t.txn_cnt_30d >= 5 THEN 'active' WHEN t.txn_cnt_30d > 0 THEN 'low_active' ELSE 'dormant' END AS activity_tag, CASE WHEN t.txn_amt_30d >= 1000000 THEN 'vip' WHEN t.txn_amt_30d >= 100000 THEN 'normal_value' ELSE 'low_value' END AS value_tag, '${biz_date}' AS tag_date FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_tag_src c LEFT JOIN ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_txn_agg t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id;

taskDefinitionList.name: load_customer_tag
taskDefinitionList.description: 将计算结果写入customer_tag表，覆盖当日分区

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.customer_tag (customer_id, tag_type, tag_value, tag_source, tagged_at, expire_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT customer_id, 'activity', activity_tag, 'transaction_agg', tag_date, DATE_ADD(tag_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY), NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_customer_tag_update', 'dag_customer_tag_update' FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_tag_calc UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, 'value', value_tag, 'transaction_agg', tag_date, DATE_ADD(tag_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY), NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_customer_tag_update', 'dag_customer_tag_update' FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_customer_tag_calc;

taskDefinitionList.name: notify_customer_tag_done
taskDefinitionList.description: 通知客户标签更新完成

emailConfig.subject: [DAG]customer_tag_update完成通知-${biz_date}
emailConfig.content: 客户标签更新已完成，业务日期：${biz_date}，请关注customer_tag表数据。
